Converts documents to PDF on your device so you can annotate them in Samsung Notes or any other PDF app.
How to use
1. Open a document in any app and tap Share.\n2. Choose \"Convert to PDF\" (NotesBridge).\n3. Tap \"Open in Samsung Notes\", or pick another app.
Choose files to convert
Supported formats
Documents are converted locally. NotesBridge has no internet permission and deletes temporary files automatically.
